mainEntity.name: When is the best time to involve Frasheski Construction for tile installation coordination in a new build or renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to involve Frasheski Construction for tile installation coordination in a new build or renovation is as early as possible in the planning phase. Early involvement allows us to integrate seamlessly with architects and other contractors, ensuring proper structural preparation, timely material orders, and efficient scheduling. This proactive approach prevents conflicts with other trades and optimizes the overall project flow from the initial design stages.
